title: fix(service-storage): a chunked completion retried after it succeeded answers the same 200, and a completed upload takes no more chunks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_

Fixes #33027

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

## What changes

Two doors in `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`, both about a chunked upload session already `completed`:

| Door | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /storage/upload/chunked/:uploadId/complete`, sent again after it succeeded | `500 INTERNAL`; session re-stamped `failed`; file stays committed | `200` with the same body as the first completion; nothing written, backend not called; session stays `completed` |
| same, the retry lists a chunk the upload does not hold | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | unchanged (the parts check still runs first) |
| `PUT /storage/upload/chunked/:uploadId/chunk/:chunkIndex` on a completed session | `200` + eTag; chunk stored for no file, parts record rewritten | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing stored or recorded |
| either door on a session `in_progress`, `failed` or `expired` | as before | unchanged (`failed` still is not a lock: a retry after a backend blip completes) |

The `200` body is built by one helper (`completedUploadBody`) for both the assembling completion and the replay, so they cannot drift. The replay answers the key the file row was committed with. No new error code: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` is the code the door already uses for "the request conflicts with where the upload stands".

## Why

A client that lost the `200` and retried (the SDK `resumeUpload` pattern) was told a committed, downloadable file had failed, and the session ledger said `failed`. Root cause: the completion door did not look at the session's terminal status; the adapter had already discarded its multipart, threw "Upload session not found", and the catch stamped `failed` over `completed`.

## Verification

- New pins in `storage-routes.test.ts`, `describe('[#33027] a completed session')`: replay `200` deep-equals the first body, `completeChunkedUpload` and `updateSession` not called, row + progress `completed`, file `committed`; a retry with a wrong eTag still `409`, row stays `completed`; chunk PUT `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `uploadChunk` not called, `parts`/`uploaded_size` unchanged; CONTROL: a re-sent chunk on an in-flight session still `200`.
- Ablation (guards replaced by `false`, fix committed first, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`): the replay pin and the chunk pin go red (`2 failed | 2 passed`); restored tree diff empty.
- Local, on `d3d6b13f` + changeset: `service-storage` `storage-routes.test.ts`, `chunked-upload-integrity.test.ts`, `storage-routes.metadata-outage.test.ts`, `chunk-part-record-concurrency.test.ts`: 169/169 passed. `service-storage` typecheck, eslint on both files, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:nul-bytes`: all exit 0. Everything else: CI.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Changeset `.changeset/33027-chunked-complete-retry.md`: `@objectstack/service-storage` patch, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Narrowing = the chunk PUT on a completed session, `200` → `409`; widening = the completion replay, `500` → `200`.
